instruction: Configure your system to automatically connect to available USB devices.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible in the OSWorld environment because USB device management requires kernel-level hardware access and device driver configuration that are not exposed in the virtual desktop environment. USB passthrough and auto-mount policies cannot be reliably controlled or verified.
